topic: Fiverr gig written with one AI prompt

hook.text: Write your Fiverr gig in 2 minutes

demo.vo: Paste this, add your skill and buyer, and AI writes the whole gig page.
demo.prompt: Write a Fiverr gig for [your skill] aimed at [your buyer]: title, description, 3 packages and 5 tags.
answer: Title: I will design a logo for your cafe
Tags: cafe logo, branding, small business
Test a starter price of $20-$40 first

payoff.vo: Paste the title into Fiverr, add the 3 packages, compare prices with similar gigs.
payoff.title: Post it today

page_prompt.title: Write your Fiverr gig in 2 minutes
page_prompt.summary: A gig title, description, 3 packages and tags you can edit
page_prompt.prompt: Write a Fiverr gig for [your skill] aimed at [your buyer]. Give me: 1) a gig title starting with 'I will' under 80 characters, 2) a 150-word description, 3) Basic, Standard and Premium packages with what's included and delivery days, 4) 5 search tags, 5) 3 questions to ask buyers. Suggest a price range for a new seller with [your experience], and say when you're not sure about a fee or rule.
page_prompt.then: Rewrite the description in a friendlier tone, under 120 words.
page_prompt.tip: Check 5 similar gigs on Fiverr and edit the answer so it sounds like you.
